title: Assertions for extension from a finite disjoint union of opens
statement: Let k be algebraically closed and f:X → Spec k a reduced curve [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting]. Let Λ be a finite commutative coefficient ring, r prime, and F a constructible module-valued etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] killed by r. For n pairwise disjoint opens U_a, put W = union U_a. The eight conditional assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] for extension by zero of F restricted to W are equivalent to all eight assertions for each extension by zero of F restricted to U_a [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Neither density nor irreducibility is assumed; n = 0 is allowed.

proof.text: Let W be the union of the given finitely many pairwise disjoint opens. The extension-by-zero counits give a morphism from the finite direct sum of the j_a! restrictions to j_! of the restriction to W. At a geometric point inside W, the unique nonzero summand maps identically to F at that point; outside W both sides are zero. Conservative geometric stalks make this an isomorphism. Each summand is constructible on the open-closed stratification and killed by r.

Cohomology and inverse image are additive and comparison maps are natural in the sheaf. Thus each cohomology group and each field-extension or open-restriction map for the finite sum is the finite direct sum of those for the summands. A finite sum is zero or finite exactly when every summand is, and a finite sum of maps is bijective or surjective exactly when each summand map is. Apply these facts to C1-C8. The affine and proper conditions are shared by all the summands. For the conditional coefficient requirements use that r-primary coefficients are either all invertible away from r, all primary at r, or zero when an exceptional condition applies. When n = 0 the sheaf is zero and the universal statement on Fin 0 is vacuous.

theorem assertions_iff_disjoint_open_prime (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] [IsReduced X]
    (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime] (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    [Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf F] (hF : r • 𝟙 F = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → X.Opens)
    (hU : Pairwise (fun a b ↦ Disjoint (U a : Set X) (U b))) :
    IsCurve.Assertions Λ f
      (((⨆ a, U a).ι)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj
        (((⨆ a, U a).ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F)) ↔
      ∀ a, IsCurve.Assertions Λ f
        (((U a).ι)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj
          (((U a).ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F))
